name: Hiiragi Shinobu
source: A lively rich girl who's the president of the mystery club. A 3rd year middle schooler. Ushio's childhood friend. She hates her name because she thinks it sounds boyish, so she insists that people call her Shino-chan. She's the one who comes up with a plan to visit the haunted inn on an isolated island during typhoon.
